long_biography.plain_text:
Ruslan Almakaev worked as deputy general director of the Eurasia trading and industrial company before moving into the Russian Aviation Fund. That public organisation supported air-force personnel and workers in the aviation industry; he served as its deputy general director before entering Sistema.

Within the group, he led non-corporate restructuring and subsequently became general director of Sistemny Project. He also sat on the strategy committee, which examined development questions affecting the parent company and its businesses. He chaired NTR Region and served on the boards of Sistema Mass Media and Sistema Invest.
